title: A shared rule meets a change
meaning: Shared principles support you when loyalty to an agreement allows changed conditions to reshape how you act.
text: Deciding together is easier when you have a clear foundation: why you are doing something and which promises you consider binding. The Hierophant in the physical position of Manipura appears through following an accepted agreement and drawing on an established method or trusted experience. The Hierophant in energy supplies the motive, remaining faithful to shared principles and belonging to the same undertaking. The Wheel of Fortune in emotions makes changing circumstances especially noticeable. A welcome turn delights you; an unexpected setback changes the mood. Your rule provides support while circumstances retain their freedom.

For example, you decide to take unwanted books regularly to a community book exchange. On the agreed day, it is closed for repairs. **Being faithful to an intention may require a new way to act.** Finding another exchange or postponing the trip can preserve your wish to share. The decision survives changed conditions, and disappointment need not mean the undertaking has lost its purpose.

The difficulty is confusing a principle with one familiar procedure. If changing the route feels like breaking a promise, effort goes into preserving the form while irritation gathers around circumstances. Your mood starts depending on the world following your timetable. Shared will grows firmer when you distinguish what truly matters from details you can revise without losing trust or respect for your agreement.
